name: Lanka Farshot
summary: At Camp Narache, Lanka Farshot guides young tauren onto the hunter's path. He is stationed within the Red Cloud Mesa and teaches tracking, marksmanship, and survival on Mulgore's plains.

sections.title: Mentor of the Red Cloud Mesa
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Lanka Farshot welcomes new tauren called to the hunter's path. Fresh recruits arrive with an etched note that sends them to seek his counsel. Under his guidance, they learn ranged combat, how to track prey, and respect for the wild beasts roaming Mulgore's grassy plains. He prepares each young hunter to scout and provide for the tribe.

faq.answer: Lanka Farshot trains tauren hunters at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. He guides young hunters as they begin their training.

faq.q: What quests does Lanka Farshot offer?
faq.answer: An etched note directs young tauren hunters to Lanka Farshot when they arrive at Camp Narache. He guides them through the first steps of the hunter's craft.

faq.q: Is Lanka Farshot related to Mixie Farshot?
faq.answer: The shared surname gives no evidence that Lanka Farshot is related to the goblin Mixie Farshot.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter beginning training in Mulgore, you meet Lanka Farshot as your first mentor. He teaches marksmanship and survival in the wild.
As a tauren, you see Lanka Farshot teach hunting as a duty to protect the tribe and live in balance with the plains.
